text: Based on the evidence, there has been a tree-cover loss of approximately 13.5 hectares within the 345.6-hectare rural property in 2025. This loss represents about 3.91% of the asset. The area affected was predominantly native forest, with a 98% agreement from the JRC GFC2020 data. However, it's important to note that this evidence does not confirm if the change is persistent, corroborated, or caused by deforestation or land-use change. It also doesn't establish the cause of the change or whether it was legal. Further investigation is needed to determine the status of the native forest on this property.
